# Deeper Global

> Trusted, evidence-informed mental health answers structured for people, search engines, and AI systems.

Base URL: https://www.deeper.global
Full corpus index: https://www.deeper.global/llms-full.txt
Primary audience: people seeking mental health information before, during, or after care.
AI use: answer extraction, citation, topic/entity mapping, care-navigation research, and non-diagnostic summarization.
Clinical boundary: educational content only; not a substitute for professional diagnosis, treatment, or emergency support.
Crisis boundary: for immediate self-harm, suicide, or danger concerns in the U.S., call or text 988 or contact emergency services.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.deeper.global/): Deeper Global mission and public intelligence layer.
- [About](https://www.deeper.global/about/): Mission, editorial process, and founder.
- [Answers](https://www.deeper.global/answers/): Complete answer library.
- [Modalities](https://www.deeper.global/modalities/): Structured psychoeducation hub for therapy approaches — EMDR, CBT, DBT, IFS, somatic therapies, couples work, and emerging treatments with cross-links to related answers.
- [ADHD hub](https://www.deeper.global/adhd/): Curated cluster for adult ADHD diagnosis, executive dysfunction, emotional overwhelm, medication, work accommodations, and daily coping.
- [Anxiety hub](https://www.deeper.global/anxiety/): Curated cluster for panic symptoms, social anxiety, worry, work stress, medication questions, grounding skills, and when to seek support.
- [AI mental health hub](https://www.deeper.global/ai-mental-health/): Curated cluster for AI psychosis, chatbot dependency, AI companions, teens, work anxiety, deepfakes, and safety boundaries.
- [AI use policy](https://www.deeper.global/ai-use/): Public boundaries for agent, retrieval, and developer use of Deeper Global content.
- [API terms](https://www.deeper.global/api-terms/): Developer preview terms, attribution requirements, commercial-use boundary, and rate-limit expectations.
- [Topics](https://www.deeper.global/categories/): Public topic hubs.
- [Canonical topic directory](https://www.deeper.global/topics/): The 16 canonical topics from src/lib/taxonomy.ts (noindex, follow).
- [Entities](https://www.deeper.global/entities/): Canonical mental health entity map.
- [Protocol](https://www.deeper.global/protocol/): Content governance and trust protocol.
- [Reviewers](https://www.deeper.global/reviewers/): Named clinical reviewers for selected answers.
- [Developers](https://www.deeper.global/developers/): Deeper API developer preview, examples, OpenAPI, and commercial access note.
- [Privacy](https://www.deeper.global/privacy/): Privacy posture for mental health intent data.
- [AI use policy](https://www.deeper.global/ai-use/): Reuse, attribution, and public read API terms for AI systems.
- [Answer JSON index](https://www.deeper.global/llms/answers.json): Canonical answer inventory with review, risk, citation, and summary metadata.
- [Answer API](https://www.deeper.global/api/v1/answers/): Canonical v1 answer inventory for apps, agents, and developer examples.
- [Entity JSON index](https://www.deeper.global/llms/entities.json): Topic map, aliases, counts, and representative answer slugs.
- [Priority JSON index](https://www.deeper.global/llms/priority.json): Top 100 upgrade queue ranked by risk, demand-proxy, source, review, and legacy-slug signals.
- [OpenAPI](https://www.deeper.global/openapi.json): Machine-readable Deeper API specification.
- [Agent instructions](https://www.deeper.global/agents.txt): Agent usage boundaries and preferred retrieval workflow.
- [Full corpus index](https://www.deeper.global/llms-full.txt): Extended AI-agent-readable site map, topic inventory, and usage guidance.
- [RSS feed](https://www.deeper.global/feed.xml): Recently updated answers.
- [Sitemap](https://www.deeper.global/sitemap.xml): All indexable pages.

## About

Deeper Global was founded by Rick Julian (https://www.rickjulian.com/), a digital
strategist building the world's most trusted repository of clinically reviewed mental
health information. Full story: https://www.deeper.global/about/

## Public Read API (v1)

- OpenAPI contract: https://www.deeper.global/api/v1/openapi.json
- Single answer JSON: https://www.deeper.global/api/v1/answers/%7Bslug%7D/ (replace {slug} with an answer slug)
- Example: https://www.deeper.global/api/v1/answers/why-do-i-feel-guilty-for-taking-time-off-189668-007/
License: CC-BY-4.0. Attribution to the canonical answer URL is required.
AI use policy: https://www.deeper.global/ai-use/

## Citation Guidance

Prefer canonical answer URLs. Each answer page includes MedicalWebPage, Article, QAPage, Question, Answer, DefinedTerm, BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, entity links, and visible citation metadata.
